trap-nonspeakable.notes: CROSS-BLOCK FINDING (report, not fixed) - THIS BLOCK REFUTES ITS OWN SIBLING, and this block is the correct one. The proof establishes |Branch| in {0,1,2,5,6,7,10,11,12,...} (non-negative combinations of one 5-orbit size and at most two fixed points) together with |Branch| = 2g+2. Taking the even members at least 6 gives 6, 10, 12, 16, 20, 22, 26, ... hence g in {2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 12, ...}. In particular g=6 would require |Branch| = 14, and 14 is not in the list (14 - 0, 14 - 1, 14 - 2 = 14, 13, 12, none divisible by 5); g=8 fails the same way. But rem:hyperelliptic-z5-classification-interpretation item 2 says dropping minimality yields 'genera g in {4, 5, 6, ...}'. The remark's own g=4 'two size-5 orbits' example is right; the set-listing should read {4, 5, 7, ...}. Verified independently before reading this proof, then confirmed by it.
